name: worldquest

scripts.generate: pnpm design:tokens && pnpm i18n:types && pnpm edge:build
scripts.verify: pnpm generate && pnpm status:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:backend-boundaries && pnpm test && pnpm content:validate && pnpm content:crosscheck && pnpm content:preview --quiet && pnpm i18n:check && pnpm design:contrast && pnpm lint:a11y && pnpm escape-hatches && pnpm reachability && pnpm check:sql && pnpm five-states && pnpm scrollable && pnpm engines:simulate && pnpm check:eas
scripts.test: node --test scripts/lib/browser-harness.test.cjs scripts/security-regressions.test.cjs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" --fail-if-no-match test && vitest run --config vitest.edge.config.ts
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @worldquest/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../node_modules/.cache/wq-web && node apps/mobile/e2e/flow.cjs node_modules/.cache/wq-web node_modules/.cache/wq-e2e-shots
scripts.design:shots: pnpm --filter @worldquest/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../node_modules/.cache/wq-web && node scripts/design-shots.cjs
scripts.edge:deploy: supabase functions deploy submit-lesson --project-ref tjdjogidudjobxipibqb && supabase functions deploy store-notifications --no-verify-jwt --project-ref tjdjogidudjobxipibqb
scripts.screenshot: esbuild scripts/screenshot/render.tsx --bundle --platform=node --resolve-extensions=.web.tsx,.web.ts,.web.jsx,.web.js,.tsx,.ts,.jsx,.js,.json --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --alias:react-native=react-native-web --alias:@worldquest/design=./packages/design/src/index.ts --alias:@worldquest/engines=./packages/engines/src/index.ts --alias:@worldquest/i18n=./packages/i18n/src/index.ts --alias:@worldquest/analytics=./packages/analytics/src/index.ts --define:__DEV__=false --alias:expo-linear-gradient=./scripts/screenshot/linear-gradient-web.tsx --loader:.json=json --loader:.png=dataurl --loader:.webp=dataurl --outfile=node_modules/.cache/wq-render.cjs && node node_modules/.cache/wq-render.cjs > node_modules/.cache/wq-app.html && node scripts/screenshot/shoot.cjs node_modules/.cache/wq-app.html docs/design/assets/screens
scripts.a11y:tree: pnpm --filter @worldquest/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../node_modules/.cache/wq-web && node scripts/a11y-tree.cjs
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm bundle:native && pnpm e2e && pnpm a11y:tree
